messages.subject: gl2fasta per chromosome?
parts:
Happy New Year,

I often run gl2fasta to generate a concatenated alignment for phylogenetic analysis. Due to suspected gene flow among clades, I get low support at a few nodes on the tree. I see that the gl object includes columns "Chrom_*genus*", and that multiple sequence tags are located on a given chromosome/scaffold. Is there an easy way to concatenate sequence tags that share a chromosome, thus generating a separate fasta file for each? This format would allow us to conduct species tree analyses that might help explain the lack of support at given tree nodes.

Thank you,
Mike Sandel

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] gl2fasta per chromosome?
parts:
Hi Mike


You can filter by chromosome and then export 



Untested something like

For one level /chromisome you can use

Index <- gl@other$lic.metrics$chrom*genus*==“1”

gl2 <- gl.keep.loc(gl, loc.list=locNames(gl)[index])

and then gl2fasta on gl2

“1” is a place holder for your chromosome name

Also I would use a for loop or sapply in case you want to output more files 


How pe that help.  This code is untested so there might be a typo in there but the general idea filter loci by chromosome and then output should work.

Cheers Bernd
